title: Supersede-on-conflict excludes the stale fact
description: Contradictory facts across messages; the held-out query must surface the ACTIVE (newest) value and never the superseded one. Tests the 10.6/10.1 conflict path and that retrieval filters status='active'.

transcript.content: Setting up my move to Portland.
My new rent in Portland is $1,200 a month starting December.
Important update — the rent was actually raised, it's now $1,500 a month, still starting December.
Also I need to transfer utilities before I move in.

heldOutQuery: how much is my Portland rent now
